draft.reply_body:
Hello,

Thanks for letting us know. Whether the €150 comes back in full depends on when the cancellation was made relative to the booking's scheduled pickup time: bookings cancelled more than 48 hours ahead of pickup are refunded in full, cancellations made inside that 48-hour window keep half the booking value, and a cancellation made after pickup has already happened keeps the first rental day.

I'm checking RB-20265176 against its original pickup time now to confirm which of those applies, and I'll come back to you shortly with the exact refund amount and when to expect it.

Best regards,
Customer Service
Haapaharju Oy
